mentions.name: UniBone/QBone BuildRoot OS image
mentions.description: This project builds a new OS image for UniBone/QBone using BuildRoot and a streamlined kernel, targeting a sub-five-second boot time so users can start using the host PDP-11 almost immediately.
mentions.problem: Existing OS images for UniBone/QBone take too long to boot, delaying access to the host PDP-11.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm creating a new OS image for UniBone/QBone based on BuildRoot and a streamlined kernel. My goal is sub-five second boot time so you can get to using the host PDP-11 pretty much right away.

evidence.value: I'm creating a new OS image for UniBone/QBone based on BuildRoot and a streamlined kernel. My goal is sub-five second boot time so you can get to using the host PDP-11 pretty much right away.
